MultiplierOverride.Name: Multiplier Override
MultiplierOverride.Hint: Halving and doubling pills always apply after plus and minus bonuses, and sort to the right of them to reflect the order.

NoMultiplierStacking.Name: No Multiplier Stacking
NoMultiplierStacking.Hint: Multiple halving or multiple doubling pills do not stack; duplicates beyond the first have no effect and show as inactive.

PillDamageEditor.Name: Pill Damage Editor
PillDamageEditor.Hint: Replaces the Draw Steel Target Damage edit damage dialog with the modifier pill window: named pills with effect tooltips, halves, doubles, custom deltas, and surge spending for hero sourced damage. Turn off to use the original editor.

ResolutionHolds.Name: Post-Roll Resolution Holds
ResolutionHolds.Hint: When a strike's roll posts and a creature has a post-roll trigger against it (such as retroactive banes), the resolution goes on the stack and the message's damage and effect rows are locked until the triggers are decided. Requires Draw Steel Target Damage for the row locks and tier updates.

DebugMode.Name: Debug Mode
DebugMode.Hint: Log trigger detection details to the console.

ChatReminders.Name: Chat Reminders
ChatReminders.Hint: Whisper a reminder to an ability's owner when its trigger condition may have occurred.

SpentTracking.Name: Track Triggered Actions
SpentTracking.Hint: Track when a combatant spends their triggered action and stop reminding them about non-free triggers until the next round.

RollLock.Name: Roll Lock
RollLock.Hint: Hold ability rolls while triggered abilities that could interrupt them wait for a Use or Decline decision. Only applies during combat.

DamagePrompts.Name: Damage Prompts
DamagePrompts.Hint: When a creature takes damage, dies, or becomes winded, matching triggered abilities appear in the Trigger Stack with Use and Decline instead of a chat reminder.

DamageInterrupts.Name: Damage Interrupts
DamageInterrupts.Hint: Hold incoming damage before it lands when the target or an ally has a triggered ability that modifies it, such as halving. The Director confirms the final amount after triggers resolve. Only applies during combat.

FmInterrupts.Name: Forced Movement Interrupts
FmInterrupts.Hint: Forced movement made through Combat Tools is held before it starts when a creature has a movement-modifying trigger against it (Lines of Force, Repel, Explosive Assistance). Used triggers reduce, boost, or redirect the movement; declines let it proceed unchanged. Requires Draw Steel Combat Tools.

StackDecisionTimer.Name: Stack Decision Timer
StackDecisionTimer.Hint: Triggers on the stack auto-decline after the Roll Lock Grace Period elapses with no decision. Choosing Use grants the rest of the group fresh time.

RollLockGrace.Name: Roll Lock Grace Period
RollLockGrace.Hint: After Use is chosen for a triggered ability, the held roll resumes when that ability's message is posted, or after this many seconds if it never posts (for cancelled flows).

PrimaryGamemaster.Name: Primary Gamemaster
PrimaryGamemaster.Hint: The Director who resolves the trigger stack. Any other Gamemaster is an assistant: they can still use a trigger they own, they just do not arbitrate. The first Gamemaster to load claims the seat, and it can be reassigned here.

Mode.resolution: holds the resolution after the roll

Detail.MaliceImplicit: Malice feature: offered at the start of the creature's turn.
Detail.Unrecognized: The parser could not confidently read this trigger. Reminders only.
Detail.EventNeedsTier: {event}: needs a compatibility tier to detect.
Detail.ScopeNeedsTier: Scope {scope}: needs a compatibility tier to resolve.
Detail.BespokeEffect: Bespoke effect: the trigger is detected, but the effect depends on this ability's own roll. Apply it manually from its posted message.
Detail.DamageModifying: Damage modifying: incoming damage is held while this ability is decided.
Detail.TargetedHalf: Halves on use: using this from a roll lock pre-halves the incoming damage.
Detail.RollModifying: Roll modifying: using this applies {effect} to the triggering roll.
Detail.Redirect: Redirects on use: the triggering strike is retargeted {mode}.
Detail.Revisit: Marked for a later revisit; not detected yet.
Detail.DsctOnly: Needs Draw Steel: Combat Tools data to detect.

RedirectMode.chooser: to a chosen target (manual pick for now)
RedirectMode.swap: to this ability's owner, who switches places with the original target
RedirectMode.after: to this ability's own target, with a manual update reminder posted on use

Editor.Title: Trigger Builder: {name}
Editor.OpenTooltip: Open the trigger builder to override how this trigger is automated.
Editor.NoTriggerText: This ability has no trigger text.
Editor.QualEffectCost: Enforced: only an ability costing {n} or less, or more if the owner can pay for it.
Editor.QualEffectTargets: Enforced: only an ability targeting exactly {n} {side}.
Editor.QualEffectNone: Descriptive only. Shown in reminders, not enforced.
Editor.OwnerUnacted: Only if this creature has not acted this round
Editor.AnyHeroUnacted: Only while any hero has not acted this round
Editor.HoldDamageHint: The damage is held before it lands while the owner decides, so the effect can change it. Unchecked, the trigger only prompts after the damage applies.
Editor.TargetedHalf: Halves the incoming damage when used
Editor.TargetedHalfHint: When this ability is used from the roll lock, the strike's damage buttons are pre-halved for this creature.
Editor.ExcludeSelfTarget: Not if the triggering ability also targets this creature
Editor.ExcludeSelfTargetHint: The trigger is skipped when this ability's owner is among the triggering ability's targets, like the Orc Rampart's No.
Editor.PostRollHint: This trigger fires after the strike's roll posts instead of locking it beforehand. The message's damage and effect rows are held until the trigger is decided.
Editor.HalfOnUseHint: Using this trigger halves the strike's damage buttons for the struck target, like Shriek.
Editor.RollModHint: Using this trigger modifies the triggering roll. From a pre-roll lock the modifier is applied in the roll dialog when the roll resumes; on a post-roll trigger the tier is recomputed for the struck target.
Editor.RedirectHint: Using this trigger retargets the strike. Self and reflect apply automatically from a pre-roll lock; chooser and swap need manual follow-up; the post-roll option posts a manual retarget card.
Editor.RedirectSelf: This ability's owner becomes the target
Editor.RedirectChooser: A chosen creature becomes the target (manual pick)
Editor.RedirectSwap: Owner becomes the target and switches places

EventDesc.TAKES_DAMAGE: A creature loses Stamina to damage. Prompts on the stack after the damage lands.
EventDesc.WOULD_TAKE_DAMAGE: Damage is about to land on a creature. The damage is held until the triggers resolve.
EventDesc.DEALS_DAMAGE: A creature deals damage to another creature. Reminder only for now.
EventDesc.DIES: A creature drops to 0 Stamina. Prompts on the stack.
EventDesc.WINDED_OR_DYING: A creature becomes winded or dying. Prompts on the stack.
EventDesc.TARGETED_BY_STRIKE: A strike targets the watched creature. Locks the roll until decided.
EventDesc.TARGETED_BY_ABILITY: Any ability targets the watched creature, strike or not. Locks the roll until decided.
EventDesc.MAKES_STRIKE: A creature makes a strike. Locks the roll until decided.
EventDesc.POWER_ROLL: A creature makes a power roll. Locks the roll until decided.
EventDesc.MOVES: A creature moves, shifts, or leaves a square. Needs the Combat Tools tier.
EventDesc.FORCE_MOVED: A creature is pushed, pulled, or slid. Needs the Combat Tools tier.
EventDesc.FORCE_MOVES: A creature force moves someone else. Needs the Combat Tools tier.
EventDesc.TURN_START: A creature's turn begins. Chat reminder.
EventDesc.TURN_END: A creature's turn ends. Chat reminder.
EventDesc.ROUND_START: A new combat round begins. Chat reminder.
EventDesc.CONDITION_GAIN: A creature gains a condition such as bleeding or prone. Not detected yet.
EventDesc.USES_ABILITY: A creature uses an ability, action, or maneuver. Not detected yet.
EventDesc.POWER_ROLL_RESULT: A specific power roll outcome, like tier 1 or a critical. Not detected yet.
EventDesc.ZONE_ENTER: A creature enters a linked zone or area. Not detected yet.
EventDesc.ZONE_TURN_START: A creature starts its turn inside a linked zone. Not detected yet.
EventDesc.EFFECT_ENDS: A named effect on a creature ends. Not detected yet.
EventDesc.SAVING_THROW: A creature makes a saving throw. Not detected yet.
EventDesc.REGAINS_STAMINA: A creature regains Stamina. Chat reminder.
EventDesc.MARKED: The watched creature is marked. Needs Draw Steel: Combat Tools data.
EventDesc.RESOURCE_GAIN: A creature gains a heroic resource. Special case abilities only.
EventDesc.STAMINA_BELOW: Stamina falls below a set threshold. Special case abilities only.
EventDesc.MECHANISM: A siege engine or mechanism is operated. Special case abilities only.
EventDesc.NARRATIVE: A narrative moment the Director calls for. Never automated.
EventDesc.GRAB_ENDS: A grab on the watched creature ends. Special case abilities only.
EventDesc.RESISTS_POTENCY: A grabbed creature resists a potency. Special case abilities only.
EventDesc.TEST_FAILED: An ally fails a test. Special case abilities only.
EventDesc.UNKNOWN: The parser could not classify this trigger. Reminder only.

Editor.ScopeHint: Who the event must happen to, from this ability's owner's point of view.
Editor.RangeHint: How close the triggering creature must be to this ability's owner. Ability distance uses the range printed on the ability, such as Melee 1.
Editor.QualifiersHint: Extra conditions from the trigger text, displayed as pills that can be hovered over for details or disabled to loosen requirements.
Editor.DamageTypesHint: For damage events only: fire the trigger just for these damage types. None selected means any type.
Editor.AbilityDsidHint: Only fire when the causing ability's Draw Steel ID matches, e.g. gore.
Editor.GroupNameHint: For the Group scope: the event must happen to a creature with this keyword (or this word in its name).
Editor.ChecksHint: Availability gates checked at the moment the event happens.
Editor.MaliceHint: Malice actions are offered to the Director on the acting creature's turn and never spend a triggered action.
Editor.SaveHint: Stores this configuration on the ability and stops using the automatic parser.
Editor.ResetHint: Deletes the override and returns this ability to the automatic parser.
